name: Papua New Guinea
prevalence_note: On 6 July 2025 the Bank of Papua New Guinea issued an urgent public advisory on unlicensed 'investment' offers circulating on WhatsApp, Facebook and Telegram, including promises of extreme short-term profits, and stated that it had not licensed any virtual-asset or cryptocurrency investment platform. The Securities Commission has since repeated that investment-scam reports remain a live concern, and the National Cyber Security Centre tells people how to report suspicious calls, mail or messages to the Centre, the Police Cybercrime Unit, or their bank.
cross_border_note: Papua New Guinea uses +675. Promoters on WhatsApp or Telegram may sit outside the country; a kina-denominated promise or a local-looking transfer instruction does not mean the scheme is supervised by the Bank of PNG.

scams.name: Unlicensed social-media investment or crypto scheme promising extreme short-term profits
scams.name_en: Bank of Papua New Guinea 6 July 2025 advisory: unregulated WhatsApp, Facebook and Telegram offers promise outsized returns in hours and often operate as Ponzi or pyramid schemes; no VASP has been licensed
context_keywords: Bank of Papua New Guinea licence check
direct bank transfer for guaranteed profit

red_flag_keywords.text: transfer kina to this unofficial account
invest more now to keep the returns coming

scams.signals_en: Bank of PNG warned of WhatsApp, Facebook and Telegram schemes promising huge payouts within 28 hours or hundreds of percent via direct bank transfers. Unregistered promoters run Ponzi/pyramid schemes; BPNG has licensed no crypto VASPs.
scams.legit_en: Before placing money in Papua New Guinea, check the provider's licence with the Bank of PNG. Supervised firms never promise overnight multi-fold profits, and losses on unlicensed schemes may leave investors with no recourse.
bait_tactics: Say the offer will be compared with the Bank of Papua New Guinea's licensed-institution lists before any kina is sent.
Ask why a supervised investment would need a direct credit into an account named only in a WhatsApp group.
Refuse to increase the stake in order to 'keep' a return that has not been paid out through a supervised firm.

scams.name: Fake trading app or phishing link dressed as an investment opportunity
scams.name_en: Securities Commission of PNG awareness: fake websites, search-result phishing links that request personal data, and unregulated trading apps used to lure downloads and investments
context_keywords: Securities Commission of Papua New Guinea

red_flag_keywords.text: enter your details on this investment page
the trading app is not supervised in PNG
search result for a licensed broker look-alike

scams.signals_en: In Oct 2025 the Securities Commission (SCPNG) warned of suspicious investment sites, search-result phishing links stealing personal data, and unregulated trading apps urged for download and funding, advising checks with SCPNG and BPNG.
scams.legit_en: Verify any securities offer in Papua New Guinea with SCPNG and the Bank of PNG before downloading an app or entering personal data on a search link. Official agencies never recruit investors via unregulated chat apps.
bait_tactics: Say the entity will be verified with the Securities Commission and the Bank of PNG before an app is installed.
Refuse to type passwords or identity documents into a page that appeared as a search result or arrived in a message.
Propose going further only once the promoter has been found on an official licence or registration list.
